text_block_list.text: —My daily life since becoming a trainer at Tracen Academy.

Watching over the girls during training,
and daydreaming about the brilliant, unseen future ahead was peaceful...

I hoped to take someone under my wing one day
and support their growth, but...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
RAAAAAAAAAAAAGH!!
OUTTA MY WAAAAAAAY!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*...
Damn it... Where is it?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Dammit, I can't find 'em! The Golshi Radar
was definitely pointin' right here—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —GASP!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"BEEP... Radar signal received. Signal received.
Trainer reaction detected in vicinity."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
If the radar's reactin', there's no mistakin' it!!
There's gotta be a trainer around here!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
But... where? If I remember right, trainers are
green-skinned creatures with exposed fangs—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —Oho!!

My eyes locked with the bizarre horsegirl standing right in front of me.
...I had a very bad feeling about this.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Could it be that YOU'RE a trainer?!
choice_data_list: I don't have green skin or exposed fangs!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Whatcha talkin' about?
Anyone wearin' a trainer badge is a trainer, ain't they?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Sheesh, quit makin' zero sense!
Act like that and you're gonna get snatched up by some horsegirl lookin' for a scout, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: For instance... into someone like the great Gold Ship!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Your luck's officially run out! Time to catch me a wild trainer, ORAAAAAAAAGH!!

The horsegirl calling herself Gold Ship started closing in fast!
If I stay here, something terrible is going to happen...!!
Sensing mortal danger, I turned on my heels and bolted—!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey...!! You punk, get back hereeeeee!!

By the time I managed to flee behind the school building,
the horsegirl named Gold Ship was finally nowhere in sight.
Still, what on earth was that just now...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Excuse me... Are you all right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You seem terribly out of breath.
Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, Gold Ship-san?!
Well, how should I put it... you have my deepest condolences.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
However, why on earth would she
be chasing after you?
choice_data_list: She seemed to be looking for a trainer...
She seemed to be looking for a trainer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I see... She certainly has plenty of passion
when it comes to wanting to race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
For an Umamusume to enter official races,
having a Trainer is an absolute necessity.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
However, Gold Ship is... elusive, to say the least.
Or perhaps impossible to grasp, or... well...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
At any rate, having struggled to find a Trainer,
she must have decided to capture one by force...

It seems this Gold Ship girl
is quite the handful.

Her passion for racing is admirable,
but honestly, I'm not sure I could keep up with her...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
WOOORAAAAGHHH!!
WHERE ARE YA, STRAY TRAINEEERRR?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh dear... It sounds like she's headed this way!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Getting tangled up with her would be troublesome, so I shall take my leave.
Please be careful yourself...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
ORA ORA ORA ORA ORAAAAHHH!!
WHERE'D YA GOOOOO?!

Not good, I have to run again!!
Just as the thought crossed my mind, however—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Aha! Stray Trainer, spoootted♪

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: And hup—
(*SWOOSH!!*)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: OOORAAAH!! Target secured!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there, don't look so spooked.
It's not like I'm gonna eat ya or anything.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I just need ya to tag along for a teeny-tiny grand adventure.
And with that, full steam aheaaad!!

Stuffed into a sack and slung over her shoulder,
I was hauled off to parts unknown...
A few hours later—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Clear skies! Grade-A! Scorchin' sunshine!
Perfect weather for some treasure huntin'!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty then! Time for Golshi-chan's Heart-Poundin'☆Thrillin'!?
Treasure Hunt Tour to kick off!!
Where on earth... is this place?! (To be continued)
